parsed.why: State courts repeatedly enjoin anti-trans laws; no in-force facility ban; youth care protected. Weighed against national document/entry regime, religious-refusal statute, no state GI hate-crime coverage, flag/drag limits.

Most Protective tier: shield law, full GI nondiscrimination in accommodations/employment, GI hate-crime coverage, no facility bans, accessible markers. National passport/entry regime still binds at the border, capping the ceiling.

Worst local record: care ban upheld, custody hormone funding bar (reaches detained traveller), reporting tipline, no GI nondiscrimination, surgical document rule, sports ban. Hostile state institutions, thin recourse, below national baseline.

Rated among harshest for adults: Feb 2026 licence-marker ban ending changes, pending facility/birth-sex bill, youth care ban, conversion therapy legal. Mitigated by no in-force facility ban, GI hate-crime statute, two protective cities.

Statutory GI civil-rights protection in public accommodations (visitor-facing), GI hate-crime law, panic-defence repeal, X marker and accessible birth-certificate changes, low-risk assessment. Youth-only school policies don't reach adults; national document regime still applies.
